units.name: Department of Industrial Engineering
units.evidence: Official department page establishes actual Industrial Engineering department and substantive manufacturing/service resource integration, efficiency and logistics research/education scope.

decisions.reason: Imported bare university is institutional placeholder. Actual Industrial Engineering department independently verified; historical parent wording in URL not treated as current official faculty name.

sources.note: Entire official Department of Industrial Engineering About Us read. Actual department, substantive efficiency/resource integration in manufacturing and services, logistics/health/energy applications, project-based teaching. Current parent faculty not shown, left null rather than copying old Faculty of Engineering and Architecture URL name.

Entire current Graduate Degree Programs table read. Five PhD programmes Architecture, Civil Engineering, Clinical Psychology, English Language Education, Mechanical Engineering. Industrial Engineering explicitly master’s only. Full business/humanities/technical/interdisciplinary/professional master lists include Executive MBA and Applied Data Science; not PhDs. Mechanical doctoral link is same-page hash, detailed field content not available from that link.

limitations: Detailed current business and wider engineering unit research scope not fully reviewed; parent of Industrial Engineering remains unverified.
Industrial Engineering master’s is not doctoral award. Other actual engineering doctorates require detailed field checks.
